author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal + grad-clip=0.50 (optimizer sweep) — seed=42
abstract: Further optimizer ablation on HDP‑RegCal: global-norm gradient clipping set to 0.50 to suppress gradient spikes (esp. CRI‑Off) while preserving PRS. All other hyperparameters unchanged.
